mapper.sql: SELECT TraceId AS traceId, toString(tupleElement(latest, 1)) AS generation, toString(tupleElement(latest, 15)) AS revision, toString(tupleElement(latest, 17)) AS revisionId, toString(tupleElement(latest, 2)) AS state, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(tupleElement(latest, 3)) AS archivedAt, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(tupleElement(latest, 4)) AS expiresAt, toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(tupleElement(latest, 5))) AS sourceStartTimeUnixNano, toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(tupleElement(latest, 6))) AS sourceEndTimeUnixNano, tupleElement(latest, 7) AS rootServiceName, tupleElement(latest, 8) AS rootSpanName, toString(tupleElement(latest, 9)) AS durationNano, toUInt32(tupleElement(latest, 10)) AS spanCount, toUInt32(tupleElement(latest, 11)) AS errorCount, tupleElement(latest, 12) AS status, tupleElement(latest, 13) AS services, toString(tupleElement(latest, 14)) AS checksumSha256, toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(tupleElement(latest, 16))) AS updatedAtUnixNano FROM ( SELECT TraceId, argMax( tuple( Generation, State, ArchivedAt, ExpiresAt, SourceStartTime, SourceEndTime, RootServiceName, RootSpanName, DurationNano, SpanCount, ErrorCount, Status, Services, ChecksumSha256, Revision, UpdatedAt, RevisionId ), tuple(Revision, UpdatedAt, RevisionId) ) AS latest FROM quasar_tracing.trace_archive_manifest GROUP BY TraceId )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quasar_tracing.trace_archive_spans ( ArchiveGeneration, ArchivedAt, ExpiresAt, Timestamp, TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, TraceState, SpanName, SpanKind, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, ScopeName, ScopeVersion, SpanAttributes, Duration, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Events.Timestamp, Events.Name, Events.Attributes, Links.TraceId, Links.SpanId, Links.TraceState, Links.Attributes ) SELECT toUUID(#{generation}), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{archivedAt}), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{expiresAt}), Timestamp, TraceId, SpanId, ParentSpanId, TraceState, SpanName, SpanKind, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, ScopeName, ScopeVersion, SpanAttributes, Duration, StatusCode, StatusMessage, Events.Timestamp, Events.Name, Events.Attributes, Links.TraceId, Links.SpanId, Links.TraceState, Links.Attributes FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE TraceId = #{traceId}
mapper.select: SELECT TraceId AS traceId, SpanId AS spanId, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanId, TraceState AS traceState, ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS spanName, SpanKind AS spanKind, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(Timestamp) AS timestamp, Duration AS duration, toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp)) AS startTimeUnixNano, toString(Duration) AS durationNano, StatusCode AS statusCode, StatusMessage AS statusMessage, ResourceAttributes AS resourceAttributes, ScopeName AS scopeName, ScopeVersion AS scopeVersion, SpanAttributes AS spanAttributes, Events.Name AS eventNames, arrayMap(x -> toUnixTimestamp64Milli(x), Events.Timestamp) AS eventTimestamps, arrayMap(x -> toString(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(x)), Events.Timestamp) AS eventTimeUnixNanos, arrayMap(m -> toJSONString(m), Events.Attributes) AS eventAttributes, Links.TraceId AS linkTraceIds, Links.SpanId AS linkSpanIds, Links.TraceState AS linkTraceStates, arrayMap(m -> toJSONString(m), Links.Attributes) AS linkAttributes FROM quasar_tracing.trace_archive_spans WHERE TraceId = #{traceId} AND ArchiveGeneration = toUUID(#{generation}) ORDER BY Timestamp, SpanId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quasar_tracing.trace_archive_manifest ( TraceId, Generation, Revision, RevisionId, State, ArchivedAt, ExpiresAt, SourceStartTime, SourceEndTime, RootServiceName, RootSpanName, DurationNano, SpanCount, ErrorCount, Status, Services, ChecksumSha256, UpdatedAt ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, toUUID(#{generation}), toUInt64(#{revision}), toUUID(#{revisionId}), #{state}, fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{archivedAt}), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{expiresAt}), fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(#{sourceStartTimeUnixNano})), fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(#{sourceEndTimeUnixNano})), #{rootServiceName}, #{rootSpanName}, toUInt64(#{durationNano}), #{spanCount}, #{errorCount}, #{status}, #{services,typeHandler=org.quasar.tracing.clickhouse.handler.StringListTypeHandler}, #{checksumSha256}, now64(9) )
mapper.delete: ALTER TABLE quasar_tracing.trace_archive_spans DELETE WHERE TraceId = #{traceId} AND ArchiveGeneration = toUUID(#{generation})
mapper.select:
SELECT s.TraceId AS traceId, argMin(s.ServiceName, s.Timestamp) AS rootService, argMin(s.SpanName, s.Timestamp) AS rootName, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(min(s.Timestamp)) AS startTime, toUInt64(max(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(s.Timestamp) + s.Duration) - min(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(s.Timestamp))) AS durationNs, toUInt32(count()) AS spanCount, toUInt32(countIf(s.StatusCode = 'Error')) AS errorCount, if(countIf(s.StatusCode = 'Error') > 0, 'Error', 'Ok') AS status, any(s.ResourceAttributes) AS resourceAttributes, 'archive' AS source, any(m.archivedAt) AS archivedAt
ORDER BY
durationNs spanCount startTime
ASC DESC
LIMIT ${limit} OFFSET ${offset}
